title: Naming a new component or a copy takes the keyboard again
goal: After Make Component, the new component name field should have the keyboard so typing names it. Since the 2026-11-08 sweep it does not: the keys go to the picture instead, where letters pick tools. Four walks that name a component or a copy fail the same way.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-10 at ebaf3abc (and with 07df11ac/ebaf3abc changes removed, and with 03eb6f22 reverted, so it is none of those): printf "name-field-handback\ncomponent-override-walk\n" > /tmp/two.txt; Scripts/playtest-all.sh --only /tmp/two.txt -> name-field-handback FAILED step 16 (type): no text field has the keyboard (first responder is CanvasNSView); component-override-walk FAILED step 15 (type): same. copy-own-color-walk (step 15) and copies-share-choice-walk (step 24) fail the same way. All four passed in every full sweep 2026-11-01..2026-11-08; 28 commits under Sources landed since. Each does action makeComponent (or a rename) then a type step. Bisect between the 11-08 sweep commit and b34fcb4a.
acceptance: After Make Component, typing a name and pressing Return names the component, with no click first
name-field-handback, component-override-walk, copy-own-color-walk and copies-share-choice-walk each pass twice in a row
The commit that broke it is named in the log

Broke in 7bc8dd3d6 (2026-11-09, 'The panel's rows stop under the title bar instead of sliding under Ask'): PanelTopEdge put .mask{} on the inspector's scroller, and on macOS a masked subtree drops every FocusState request made in code (claim ran, focused stayed false 0.3s later even with retries). Bisected by taking the modifier out (walks pass), then only the mask (pass), then a constant Rectangle mask (fail), then .clipped() (pass). Fix: PanelTopEdge clips the scroller and draws its scrolled fade as a .regularMaterial band over the top edge, not a mask. All 13 owned walks + panel-stays-under-the-title-bar, picture-panel-stays-under-the-title-bar, ask-adds-a-title-page pass; the four named walks passed twice in a row. Scripts/test.sh green.
